requirements.assertion: Component and branch boundaries independent of access grants; preserve leading zero external branch codes.
Jurisdiction dispute goes to National Executive with appeal to Board and Convention; no silent transfer.
Versioned authorized interpretation, subsequent reversal preserves earlier decisions.
Branch membership, card evidence, democratic rights, representative and bargaining authority distinct.
Recognition categories and dues exception distinct from active voting rights; secret award vote with applicable threshold.
Separate confidential membership discipline and appeal workflow, not employer grievance.
Dues, waiver, parent-to-component-to-branch reconciliation and subsidy.
Convention credentials, alternates, committees, quorum, resolutions; special meeting scope.
Eligibility, nominations, vacancies, office succession, oath and outgoing authority revocation.
National executive and board distinct responsibilities; equity mandates and review.
Governed expenses, finance statements, auditor scope, disbursement and retention.
Communications, referendum, amendment, oath, national president compensation; no assumed live voting/finance.
Committee mandates, chairs, term, vacancy, expenses and delegated powers.
Explicit signing delegation on grievance; no role-based implicit authority.
Release-from-duty request and evidence under applicable policy.
Trusteeship temporary authority, preservation of historical mandates, review and restoration.
Branch-specific executive and steward configuration, Sarnia example; no bespoke fork.
Branch-specific quorum, motions, notice and meeting scopes.
Electronic OR permitted paper method; disallow mixing within election; local timezone, acclamation, appeal and tie windows.
Temporary excluded management appointment suspends authority as applicable; reinstatement controlled.
Written group consent per person; reject missing consent, allow compliant alternate form.
Policy grievance direct final level; employer-originated path distinct; CIU SOP dual presidential approval.
Qualifying informal discussions pause elapsed calculation with evidence and bounded start/end.
Employer receipt and alternate form accepted; preserve source identifier.
FB ordinary three levels versus TC maximum four with permitted intermediate waiver; agreement-specific transitions, no universal skip rule.
25 days from notification/awareness, not necessarily incident.
Escalation within ten days of written decision conveyed.
Non-response escalation limit fifteen days from prior presentation, distinct from ten-day normal reply.
Normal reply ten intermediate, twenty final, thirty policy; separate clocks from member escalation.
Exclude Saturday/Sunday/designated paid holidays; calendar version and source.
Mail postmark vs delivery vs receipt trigger distinguished.
Mutual extension and applicable Alliance participation recorded.
Governed level elimination and qualifying demotion/termination direct final level.
Written abandonment, missed escalation and beyond-control exception; no automatic irreversible closure.
Adjudicability and Alliance approval/representation where required; no universal referral.
Executive signature, full handoff packet, national LRO restricted grant and receipt.
Restricted PSI and medical evidence, classification and redacted export.
Statutory classification and statement-of-duties pathways distinct from ordinary agreement grievance.
EB B / FB C / PA D / SV I / TC T appendix mapping; dated cohort and option decisions.
employer representative cannot hear same grievance at multiple levels (FB/PA/SV/TC 18.11; verify EB37.11).
rule selection must scope employer, classification, agreement version, effective date, procedural route; reject RCMP-only TC XX article for CBSA TC.
PSAC good-standing exception and source authorization; no automatic removal of representation rights due to missing payroll deduction (https://psacunion.ca/node/7064).

telework letter periods and expiry separately tracked; do not apply expired temporary panel arrangements automatically (https://www.canada.ca/en/treasury-board-secretariat/services/collective-agreements/collective-bargaining/collective-bargaining-update/letter-agreement-telework-eb-pa-sv-tc.html).
valid inbound case: persisted canonical case, identity target exists, persisted run matches returned ID and mandatory audit; no empty internal ID
malformed mapped payload: no case, identity link or success event; explicit rejection
same source event repeated: same canonical entity and durable receipt, one domain effect
conflicting external ID mapping: quarantine with reason; no silent overwrite or stale link reuse
same external ID in unrelated tenant: distinct isolated outcomes; wrong connection context denied before write
concurrent retry: unique scoped key, no duplicate row, audit or notification
adapter failure before persistence: failed run; retry policy explicit, no fake completed result
failure after domain commit: durable recovery/reconciliation, no duplicate creation
audit failure: transaction rolls back or recoverable durable intermediate status; never success without mandatory audit
stale link or missing internal entity: reject or approved reconciliation; no implicit relink
payload or mapping schema evolution: versioned rules, deterministic replay and explicit drift errors
source revocation: unauthorized new ingest denied, previously imported history retained subject to policy
raw PII or credential in failure: redacted logs/receipts; restricted quarantine and retention
bulk import partial failure: counts reconcile, restart resumes only incomplete records, evidence digest and controlled rollback
cross-tenant export/event: deny unrelated case and sensitive fields; no notification before committed state
retry existing idempotency key: load authoritative persisted run and preserve failed/pending/completed disposition; no unsafe cast to success
Differentiate statutory exclusions, alternative recourse and required bargaining-agent participation; human decision required.
Group grievance participant eligibility and single portion of federal administration; refuse incompatible cohort.
Record applicable individual withdrawal and retain consent and history; no deletion of entire group matter.

requirements.source: FPSLRA ss209–214; FPSLREB individual grievances guidance
requirements.assertion: Determine eligible adjudication route and approval; final non-adjudicable decision remains distinct.

requirements.source: FPSLREB individual grievances guidance; FPSLR Regulations
requirements.assertion: Ordinary 40 calendar-day referral period, actual final response/non-response trigger, applicable exception and weekend/holiday roll-forward; not internal CBA business days.

requirements.source: FPSLR Regulations s61; FPSLREB extension guidance
requirements.assertion: Record extension application, authority, decision and effective date, including after expiry where permitted.

requirements.source: FPSLREB individual grievances guidance; Regulations s92
requirements.assertion: Human-rights notice Form 24 where applicable, recipient and filing evidence.
Route applicable directive grievances through separate NJC steps and decision authority.
Joint mediation request, abeyance and resumption; distinguish pause authority from deadline calculation.
Distinguish final binding decision and policy grievance remedy restrictions; no automatic legal conclusion.
Preserve unknown or invalid source date as an explicit exception; never fabricate filed date from import time.
Store source priority/step values and explicit mappings; unknown step cannot silently omit a mandatory procedural stage.
Separate import observation time from historical event time; synthetic imported event labelled provenance, not historical evidence.
No unauthorized overwrite of native case changes during reimport; field ownership, conflict detection and human approval.
Document bytes, malware status, cryptographic content digest, confidentiality, version and approved storage verified before availability; reference-only not imported file.
Resolve member and representative IDs through governed identity and mandate authority, not names or raw assigned_to.
Missing/foreign batch, missing receipt or zero visible rows cannot pass; require tenant-bound expected source manifest.
Unreconciled counts, stuck records and orphan links block acceptance; distinct transport status and migration acceptance.
Exact stable record/event hashes over all relevant versioned fields; no truncation-based equivalence for evidence.
Dry run validates expected storage conflicts, authority, source identity and planned operations without mutations; no claims of persisted records.
Immutable batch manifest and outcomes across re-import, with predecessor/successor references, reconciliation and governed reversal.
All historical case stages, deadlines, decisions, consent, signatures and confidentiality metadata reconciled, or explicitly quarantined.
